units.title: Redact signed queries on directory-only relative URLs and isolate per-call guard checks in the launch-options test
units.origin: CodeRabbit review 5453774941 on review-only PR #606 (the #572 delta), two actionable findings verified by the coordinator by reading the code at f9348a2
files: worker/src/chromiumLaunchOptions.test.ts (checkParameter: per-call copy of seen; optional nit on escaping wrappers only if cheap and covered)
units.finding_1: URL_VALUE = /^["']?\s*(?:(?:[a-z][a-z\d+.-]*:)?\/\/[^\s"'/]|\.{0,2}\/[\w~%.-])/i requires a path character after '/', './' or '../'. A non-URL-named attribute such as data-return="/?Signature=secret#fragment" is not matched, so redactAttribute keeps the signed query in markup persisted by fictiv.ts / xometry.ts through redactProviderPortalHtml. Fix: accept '?' or '#' immediately after the slash forms (for example \.{0,2}\/(?:[\w~%.-]|[?#])), keep the absolute, protocol-relative and existing relative cases, keep the pattern linear (no nested quantifiers).
units.finding_2: checkParameter (lines 154-179) passes one shared `seen` Set to checkGuard for every call of the wrapped variable; after the first call adds a guarded declaration to `seen`, a later call passing the same variable skips it and returns guarded:false, so checks.every() fails. Fix: pass new Set(seen) per call; cycle detection per resolution path stays.
acceptance: A1 Red first: new redaction test with data-return="/?Signature=secret#fragment", data-a="./?sig=x", data-b="../#frag" fails on the unmodified regex (query/fragment kept); green after the fix; the existing cases (/asset/c.png?Signature=..., ./d.png?sig=..., ../e.png#..., absolute, protocol-relative, the linear-time case) still pass; mutant reverting the branch fails the new test.

A2 Red first: a fixture source in chromiumLaunchOptions.test.ts where two calls pass the same guarded variable reports unguarded with the unmodified helper and guarded with the per-call copy; a self-referential fixture still terminates.
A3 npm --prefix worker run verify, npm run lint, npm run typecheck pass; hosted CI green at the PR head (the integration branch's 15 checks).

A4 DRAFT PR, base codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003, title 'OVD-645: ...', body per the template: answers the two CodeRabbit findings on #606 (thread links), no migration, release packet unchanged, production apply protected.
